description: Get the European investment funds reporting a position in one listing outside the US, written MIC:TICKER (e.g. XSTO:VOLV-B), matched by that security's ISIN. Coverage today is Swedish UCITS quarterly portfolios published by Finansinspektionen with about a two-month delay; special funds are excluded. Each row gives the fund, its manager, the reported quantity, the market value in SEK and the position's weight in the fund's assets, which is not a share of the company. Not comprehensive European ownership and not merged with SEC filings. For US registered funds use GetFundsHoldingStock.

maxResults.description: Maximum fund positions, largest value first (default 20, max 100).

periodEnd.description: Quarter end in YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-06-30); omit for the newest captured quarter.

ticker.description: Listing symbol MIC:TICKER, e.g. XSTO:VOLV-B; a provider suffix such as VOLV-B.ST also works. A bare ticker names a US listing and is answered with the company's listings outside the US to ask with.

name: GetEuropeanFundHoldings
title: European Fund Holdings
